rules.supporting_span: during the calendar year or the preceding calendar year paid wages of $1,500 or more
rules.explanation: General employer status based on wage threshold, excluding domestic service under paragraph (3).

rules.supporting_span: on each of some 10 days during the calendar year or during the preceding calendar year, each day being in a different calendar week, employed at least one individual in employment for some portion of the day
rules.explanation: General employer status based on 10 distinct-week employment days with at least one employee.

rules.supporting_span: during the calendar year or the preceding calendar year paid wages of $20,000 or more for agricultural labor
rules.explanation: Agricultural employer status based on agricultural wage threshold.

rules.supporting_span: on each of some 10 days during the calendar year or during the preceding calendar year, each day being in a different calendar week, employed at least 5 individuals in employment in agricultural labor for some portion of the day
rules.explanation: Agricultural employer status based on 10 distinct-week employment days with at least five agricultural laborers.

rules.supporting_span: paid wages in cash of $1,000 or more for such service
rules.explanation: Domestic service employer status based on cash wage threshold.

rules.supporting_span: shall not be treated as an employer with respect to wages paid for any service other than domestic service referred to in paragraph (3) unless such person is treated as an employer under paragraph (1) or (2)
rules.explanation: Domestic-service employer status does not extend to non-domestic services unless paragraph (1) or (2) also applies.
